blocks.text: HOT TUB REMOVAL FAQ
Hot Tub Removal in Nobleton — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in Nobleton?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough based on the tub’s size and condition — the number covers the whole job.

items.q: Is my hot tub too small a job to bother calling about?
a: That’s standard work for us, especially near the colleges. Removal books between move-out and move-in, documented for your landlord file.

items.q: Do I need to drain the hot tub myself before you arrive?
a: No — draining is part of the service. The Live Junk Free crew handles it safely on arrival, and you don’t need a hose, a pump, or any prep beyond making sure the area around the tub is reasonably accessible.

items.q: Is it safe to remove a hot tub that's still wired to electrical?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. If your tub has a hardwired 240V connection, we ask that a licensed electrician disconnect it before the crew arrives — we don’t disconnect live electrical ourselves, for your safety and ours.

items.q: Can you clear a hot tub from a hobby farm or rural property?
a: Yes, and it’s regular work for us on the concessions around the village. Long laneways are included at no extra charge, and crews work calmly around any animals or active operations on the property.
